proposedInvestigations.summary: If the user can supply the exact 12-wager manifest (team/market/threshold/side/displayed price/stake per wager, as was supplied for 2026-08-20 through 2026-08-23), this date can be reconciled through the same canonical import path (scripts/edgelab/import_bet_batch.py, importBatchId manual-2026-08-18-postmortem-v1) in a follow-up pass. Known qualitative lessons preserved for that follow-up: non-pitcher markets drove profit; PIT/LAD team totals were strong expressions; ATL/CWS theses were relatively thin; pitcher-prop confidence was too aggressive; favorite pricing does not make a pitcher prop low variance; an Arizona protected-F5 bet was executed beyond Bet Up To (logged as a price-discipline failure, not evidence the family should be default).
